svg.title: compose-add-comment · expanded · 160x48
svg.text: +Run `viewer FILE`, then press `j` and `k` to move.
The README's Keys section should say what this line does in a little more detail. Here's what I'd add:
move one line and stop at either end of the file; they never wrap around.
jumps to the last line and
move by hunk, and stop at the first and the last hunk.
The arrow keys do the same as
, and page up and page down move by a screen.
I checked each of these against the current build and they all behave as described, so this is only a docs change. If you want, I can open a follow-up for
wrapping around at the ends, but I'd keep it behind a setting so the default stays the same as today.
as "Line down" but the footer says "Down". We should pick one; I'd go with the help panel's wording because it's more specific.
Open a file longer than the screen
on a file with three hunks
Every one of them stopped where the docs will say it stops. The only surprise was
on the first hunk, which does nothing rather than wrapping to the last
one, and that matches the rest.
The screenshot in the README is from 0.5 and still shows the old title bar. It'd be worth refreshing it in the same PR.
A few notes for whoever picks up the wrap-around follow-up:
keep the default as it is today
put the setting next to the other viewer settings
respect it too, so the keys stay consistent
That's all from me on this line.
